meta.title: Session auto-archive
meta.description: Hides sessions that have been inactive for a configurable number of days by putting them into the archive, where they stay restorable. The threshold and the check interval are ordinary plugin settings: open Settings → Plugins, find this plugin, open the session-auto-archive row, and edit them there. Archiving is never destructive, and sessions that are running, pinned, targeted by a schedule, or inactive for less than the threshold are left alone.
